checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Coffee cup on windowsill with visible rain outside
must.why: Mug on wooden sill, raindrops on the glass.
Steam is extremely faint; only a faint wisp in the window glass in frame 3, nearly invisible near the cup.
Cosy, but it looks photorealistic rather than a hand-painted illustration.

must.item: About 6 s, no text or audio
must.why: Frames show no text; the timeline spans about 6 s; silence can't be heard but was requested.

faults.what: Steam, the key element, is barely visible
Photoreal look instead of the requested illustrated storybook style
The camera drifts and pushes in slightly, though a still camera was planned
The candle is cropped at the frame edge in later frames

summary: A very cosy, vertical, rainy-window mug scene came out, but it looks photoreal rather than illustrated and the steam is barely visible.
